nodes.label: Fluid Workflow Integration
nodes.rationale: Actions on a change model: apply can be invoked anytime, before all artifacts are done (if tasks exist), after partial implementation, interleaved with other actions. Not phase-locked; allows artifact updates if implementation reveals design issues.

nodes.label: Planning Boundary Principle
nodes.rationale: Propose creates planning artifacts only. The user request authorizes planning, not implementation. Code editing is forbidden during propose. Implementation requires a separate explicit apply invocation. This separates design from execution.

nodes.label: Intelligent Merging Principle
nodes.rationale: Agent-driven semantic merge rather than programmatic overwrite. A MODIFIED block carries the whole requirement plus surviving scenarios. Preserves content the delta does not mention. Enables idempotent sync operations.

nodes.label: Spec-Driven Workflow Schema
nodes.rationale: The spec-driven schema enforces a structured planning workflow: proposal -> specs (delta) -> design -> tasks -> implementation. This ensures changes are specified before being built, with delta specs merged into main specs on archive.
